title: Bipolar I - Manic Episode BSV and Vocal Features
content:
DOCUMENT TYPE: BSV / Vocal

BSV / VOCAL SIGNALS: During mania - High Dominance (grandiosity, pressured speech), High Arousal (decreased sleep need, agitation, rapid speech), elevated Valence (euphoria or irritable). Voice: fast rate, high pitch variability, loud volume, possible hoarse quality from overuse. Pressured speech is hallmark.

PATIENT-LANGUAGE EXAMPLES: "I haven't slept in three days and I feel amazing", "I have ten brilliant ideas right now", "Everyone is moving too slow".

COUNTER-SIGNALS / NEGATIONS: Slow speech, low energy, or low dominance during elevated mood period argues against mania. Episodic rather than chronic pressured speech.

PROVENANCE: Clinical observation and voice biomarker research on mood states.
